author: Josh Wowk
name: RSS Reader
description: Glanceable multi-feed RSS/Atom reader for Xeneon Edge — My Day style dark theme with thumbnails, source chips, and relative timestamps. Resilient multi-route fetching works with feeds that block browser CORS (Hackaday, most WordPress blogs, local BLOX/TownNews newspapers), including an optional relay you host yourself. Name a feed with "Label|https://…". Interactive: tap the header to switch feeds, tap a story for the full summary, tap Open to launch it in your browser.
